# Pete Dailey for Water District
DONATE
Pete Dailey for Santa Clara Valley Water District
# Experienced Leadership for Clean, Affordable, Reliable Water.
Pete Dailey brings steady, practical leadership to Santa Clara Valley Water District. As Chair of the Santa Clara Valley Water Commission and former Mayor of Los Altos, Pete understands how to protect our water resources, keep rates fair, and plan responsibly for the future.
## Leadership WE Can Trust
DONATE GET INVOLVED
## Meet Pete Dailey
Chair of the Santa Clara Valley Water Commission, Mayor of Los Altos, and a respected local leader. Pete has a solid record of protecting water resources, parks, and open spaces. As a father and active community volunteer, his leadership is pragmatic and transparent.
Now, he’s running for Water District 7 to guarantee every family has clean, affordable, reliable water for future generations. Want to learn more about Pete’s story?
Read Pete’s Full Story →
## Leadership We Can Trust
Pete Dailey is focused on practical, transparent solutions that strengthen our water system, protect the environment, and serve our community’s long-term needs.
### Reliable, Affordable Water
Ensure fair water rates while investing in infrastructure that delivers consistent, clean water to every household and business.
### Environmental Stewardship
Protect local streams and groundwater, expand conservation programs, and promote sustainable land management.
### Homelessness Along Waterways
Work collaboratively with cities and counties to connect unhoused residents with services while keeping waterways safe and clean.
### Transparency & Accountability
Promote open decision-making, accessible data, and responsible fiscal management at Valley Water.
## Get in touch
We are here to listen to your concerns about water quality and availability.
